title: Fix three bugs in a Python RunLengthEncoder class
description: Fix bugs in RunLengthEncoder: encode initializes count at 0 (should be 1), encode resets count to 0 on boundary (should be 1), decode repeats the digit char instead of the letter char.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in src/rle.py:
1. encode: change initial `count = 0` to `count = 1` (first character is already one occurrence)
2. encode: change reset `count = 0` to `count = 1` inside the else branch (each new group starts at 1)
3. decode: change `s[i] * count` to `s[i + 1] * count` so the letter (not the digit) is repeated
All 4 tests must pass.
